I went to school for some years, so I can read what is written on the fertilizer bag when the agro-dealer shows me. Last season I used two bags of NPK on this plot and the tubers were much bigger, so I will buy two bags of NPK for this 0.9 hectare again. Because the land is not mine, I will not spend money on manure, and I will plant with my own setts instead of those improved ones that cost too much. My family will do most of the work, but I will pay one young man from the village to work for ten days when we do the mounding and harvesting.
